basic_details.short_information: Union Public Service Commission (UPSC) has invited online recruitment applications under Special Advertisement No. 51/2026 for a total of 828 vacancies, comprising 124 posts of Principal and 704 posts of Vice Principal in the Education Department, Government of NCT of Delhi. Eligible candidates can apply online from 25 July 2026 to 14 August 2026 (up to 6 PM) through the official website https://upsconline.nic.in/ora/.

application_fee.details: Fee can be paid via Visa/Master/RuPay Credit/Debit Card, UPI, or Internet Banking. Fee once paid is non-refundable and cannot be adjusted against any other examination or selection.

age_limit.details: Age is further relaxable up to 10 years for PwBD candidates, subject to a maximum age limit of 56 years. Additional relaxations apply for Ex-Servicemen (5 years) and Central/UT Government employees (up to 5 years), as detailed in the Concessions & Relaxations section of the notification.

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: Selection will be made through a Combined Recruitment Test (CRT) to shortlist candidates for interview, followed by a Personality Test/Interview . Key details: CRT will be held on 01 November 2026 at 15 designated centres. The test is of 2 hours' duration, objective type (MCQs), available in English and Hindi, carrying a maximum of 300 marks. There is negative marking: one-third of the marks assigned to a question is deducted for each wrong answer. Weightage of CRT and Interview marks is 75:25 for determining final merit. Minimum suitability standard in interview: General/EWS – 50 marks, OBC – 45 marks, SC/ST/PwBD – 40 marks (out of 100). General Knowledge including contemporary social, economic and cultural issues Hindi and English language skills Reasoning ability and Quantitative Aptitude Educational policies & educational measurement and evaluation Management and Financial administration Office Procedure Pedagogy in Education Digital Literacy Ahmedabad, Bhopal, Chennai, Delhi, Dispur (Guwahati), Jaipur, Jammu, Kochi, Kolkata, Lucknow, Mumbai, Nagpur, Port Blair, Ranchi, and Visakhapatnam.

content_sections.heading: Application Fee
content_sections.text: Fee can be paid via Visa/Master/RuPay Credit/Debit Card, UPI, or Internet Banking. Fee once paid is non-refundable and cannot be adjusted against any other examination or selection.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Eligible candidates can apply online from 25 July 2026 to 14 August 2026 (up to 1800 Hrs) through https://upsconline.nic.in/ora/ . The process involves four modules: Account creation Universal Registration (generates a Universal Registration Number – URN) Common Application Form (CAF) Post/Vacancy-specific module (to be filled within the notified time period) Candidates must upload a photograph, capture a live photo, and upload their signature (signed thrice on plain white paper) as part of the CAF. Applications, once submitted, cannot be withdrawn or edited. Candidates are strongly advised to use their Aadhaar Card for ID verification and to apply well in advance of the closing date.

content_sections.heading: Documents Required
content_sections.text: Matriculation/10th certificate or equivalent (proof of date of birth) Degree/Diploma certificate (Master's Degree, B.Ed) Experience certificate(s) in prescribed proforma from Head(s) of Organisation/Department Caste certificate (for SC/ST/OBC candidates) in prescribed proforma OBC non-creamy layer declaration (for OBC candidates) Certificate of Disability in prescribed proforma (for PwBD candidates) Documents for change of name, if applicable Age relaxation certificates (Ex-Servicemen, Government employees, PwBD, etc.), if applicable Note: Documents like Pay Slip, Resume, Appointment Letter, Relieving Letter, or unsigned Experience Certificates must NOT be uploaded.

content_sections.heading: Important Instructions
content_sections.text: Reservation under OBC category applies only to candidates with OBC certificates issued by the Govt. of NCT of Delhi; certificates from other States/UTs will be treated as General/Unreserved. The closing date for submission of the online application is the date for determining eligibility in every respect. Candidates already in regular Government service must submit a declaration that they have informed their Head of Office/Department of their application. Candidates must provide a valid, active email ID, as all correspondence will be made through email only. No printouts or documents are to be sent to the Commission by post; they must be brought to the interview if shortlisted. Mobile phones and other electronic/communication devices are strictly banned in the examination/interview hall. Face authentication is mandatory for all candidates at the examination venue/interview hall. Furnishing false information or suppressing material facts may lead to rejection, debarment, and disciplinary/criminal action.

faq.question: Q1. How many total vacancies are there in UPSC Principal and Vice-Principal Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 828 total vacancies - 124 for Principal and 704 for Vice-Principal.

faq.question: Q2. When can candidates start applying online?
faq.answer: Online applications open on 25 July 2026 at 12:01 AM and close on 14 August 2026 at 11:59 PM.

faq.question: Q3. What is the educational qualification required for Principal and Vice-Principal posts?
faq.answer: Principal requires a Master's Degree, B.Ed, and 10 years of teaching experience as PGT or TGT. Vice-Principal requires a Master's Degree, B.Ed, and 2 years of experience as PGT or 3 years as TGT.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for this recruitment?
faq.answer: For Principal, the age limit is 35–50 years (relaxable up to 55 years for SC/ST and 53 years for OBC). For Vice-Principal, it is 35–40 years (relaxable up to 40 years for SC/ST and 38 years for OBC), calculated as of 14 August 2026.

faq.question: Q5. Is there an application fee for female candidates?
faq.answer: No. Female candidates, along with SC, ST, and PwD candidates of all categories, are exempted from the application fee.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application fee for other categories?
faq.answer: UR, General, OBC, and EWS male candidates must pay Rs. 25 online.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for UPSC Principal and Vice-Principal Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Selection involves a shortlisting criteria/recruitment test, a personal interview, and document verification.

faq.question: Q8. Where can candidates apply for UPSC Principal and Vice-Principal Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Applications must be submitted online through the UPSC ORA portal at upsconline.nic.in.
